name: Kompakkt
description: A field to embed Kompakkt 3D/media viewers.
project_description:
This module embeds the Kompakkt 3D Viewer ( https://kompakkt.de/ ) into your

Drupal system.

 Short tutorial:

Create/Edit a content type

 
 Add a new field of type 'Embed Kompakkt' and configure it to use the "URL

of the target" widget for input 
 Create/Edit a page of the content type 
 Paste the URL of a 3D model link (e.g.

 https://kompakkt.de/viewer/index.html?entity=5d6f708c72b3dc766b27d750 ) into the given field and press save 
 See the 3D model in your dataset 
 
 Link to Kompakkt: https://kompakkt.de/
